title: Mercedes-Benz V 300 Marco Polo
subtitle: 4MATIC · Original Westfalia camper · 08/2019 · Rome, Italy
description:
Mercedes-Benz V 300 Marco Polo 4MATIC combines everyday driving comfort with the freedom of a fully equipped camper. Original Westfalia conversion, first registered in August 2019, with 106,000 km. Price: €44,900.

Wake up somewhere new with an electric pop-up roof and upper double bed, a rear-seat bed and an integrated kitchen with sink, hob and refrigerator. A side awning creates a comfortable outdoor space, while Webasto stationary heating adds comfort on cooler days.

Full leather upholstery, heated front seats and navigation make every journey more comfortable. Parking cameras and sensors, adaptive cruise control and LED headlights complement the 4MATIC drivetrain for relaxed touring.

Accident history, engine output, emission class and climate-control configuration require confirmation due to differing technical records.
included:
Original Westfalia camper conversion
Electric pop-up roof and upper double bed
Integrated kitchen: sink, hob and refrigerator
Rear seats convert into a bed
Side awning
Webasto stationary heating
Dedicated camper electrics and insulation
